product_metadata.title: FURINNO Wright 3-Shelf Bookcase, Soft White
features: Features multiple color choices to suit your style
3 levels of adjustable shelf space for storage and display
Assembly made easy with clear instructions provided
Product Weight: 28. 8 lbs. Weight capacity (each shelf): 30 lbs.
description: FURINNO 17060 bookcase Series offers an array of refreshing colors that fits different styles of home. Colors include cinnamon cherry, Highland oak, Soft White and brook cherry. The contemporary stylish shelf is designed to fit small spaces and offers ample display and storage spaces. The shelf features 3 levels of shelf space and a closed back. It is made of engineered particle board tested for durability. The boards are made from recycle materials of rubber trees and the manufacturing process complies with the Green rules of production. It is easy to assemble by following the instructions given. A simple attitude towards lifestyle is reflected directly on the design of FURINNO furniture, creating a trend of simply nature. Care instructions: wipe clean with clean damped cloth. Avoid using harsh chemicals. Pictures are for illustration purposes only.
